findings.title: Async function blocks on synchronous fetch_rate call
findings.body: `converted_cents` is an async function but calls `fetch_rate` without awaiting it, so the entire event loop is blocked until the synchronous call completes. Change the call to `await fetch_rate(pair)`.

findings.title: Return type mismatch between function signature and implementation
findings.body: `converted_cents` declares a return type of `int`, but `round(amount_cents * rate)` returns a `float` when `rate` is a `Decimal`. Cast the result to `int` to match the signature.

summary.problem: The new async function blocks the event loop and returns the wrong type.
summary.done_well: The function documents its purpose and uses a dedicated rate-fetching helper.
